description: Windows CIM host inventory; no admin requirement or device runtime imports.

argv: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; [Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new(); $taskCpu=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor); $taskSystem=Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem; $taskBios=Get-CimInstance Win32_BIOS; $taskOs=Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; [ordered]@{cpu_model=($taskCpu.Name -join '; '); cpu_sockets=$taskCpu.Count; cpu_physical_cores=($taskCpu | Measure-Object NumberOfCores -Sum).Sum; cpu_logical_count=($taskCpu | Measure-Object NumberOfLogicalProcessors -Sum).Sum; memory_total_bytes=$taskSystem.TotalPhysicalMemory; system_model=$taskSystem.Model; system_manufacturer=$taskSystem.Manufacturer; bios_version=$taskBios.SMBIOSBIOSVersion; os_distribution=$taskOs.Caption} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 -Compress
